codeReview.summary: All 15 pre-existing test failures across 7 files have been correctly updated to match the current UI implementation. Each fix category was verified against the actual source components: Skeleton loading states use data-slot='skeleton', pagination uses CSS classes instead of HTML disabled attribute, pagination links are <a> tags with aria-labels not <button> elements, CardTitle renders as <div> not <heading>, TruncateId renders full text with CSS truncation, and Lucide Search icon has aria-hidden but no role='img'. All 333 tests pass with zero regressions.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Pre-Existing Test Failures section in AGENTS.md describes the failures at a high level. Now that they are fixed, this section should be removed or updated to prevent future workers from expecting these failures.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: AGENTS.md line: '15 tests fail due to prior UI refactoring... These should be fixed as part of this mission but are not new issues.'

sharedStateObservations.observation: Several UI component patterns that caused test failures are undocumented but worth recording: (1) shadcn/ui components like CardTitle, PaginationLink render as div/a not heading/button, (2) the project uses CSS-based disabled states (pointer-events-none opacity-50) rather than HTML disabled attribute, (3) Lucide icons render as SVG with aria-hidden but no role attribute, (4) loading states use Skeleton components with data-slot='skeleton' instead of text.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Verified across card.tsx, pagination.tsx, search-input.tsx, skeleton.tsx — all match test expectations.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The frontend-worker skill should note that shadcn/ui components may not render semantic HTML elements — CardTitle is a div, PaginationLink is an anchor. Tests should query by text content or aria-label rather than by role when using these components.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: CardTitle in card.tsx uses React.ComponentProps<'div'> and renders <div data-slot='card-title'>. Pagination components in pagination.tsx are <a> elements.
